title: Bounded local retrieval runtime
outcomes: Arbitrary natural-language queries return fast, bounded, inspectable evidence or a safe abstention.
constraints: SQLite is opened with immutable read-only URI flags and query_only enabled.
Retrieval must not assume an entity-specific question shape.
Successful evidence always carries a stable record citation.

quality_attributes.scenario: A broad query runs against a warm synthetic compatible index.
The CLI accesses a production projection.
Queries target decisions, projects, events, tasks, documents, and people.

risks: High-recall OR matching can favor partial generic matches.
Snippet generation may disclose more text than needed.
Index contract changes can cause silent misreads without structural validation.
